title: IT 服务台：报修到确认关闭
summary: C01 verified through Agent Browser session qa-1 against http://127.0.0.1:13000/main/: an employee submitted a repair ticket with urgency and screenshot; the service desk saw all tickets, assigned it to an engineer, and the engineer recorded handling and solution; the employee returned it for further handling, the engineer re-resolved it, and the employee confirmed and closed it. Separate employee accounts saw only their own tickets, the engineer saw only assigned tickets, the service desk saw all, and assignment/resolution/return/close notifications appeared in each role's Inbox and linked to the ticket detail. The home dashboard showed pending, overdue, being-handled, waiting-for-confirmation and per-engineer workload. One sub-behavior, the live >24 h overdue reminder, could not be fired because no ticket was 24 hours old and the product has no UI to backdate one; the 24 h process parameter, Overdue dashboard card and overdueNotifiedAt field were inspected. Environment note: Agent Browser's WebSocket containment wrapper lacks the WebSocket static constants, so a browser-side shim was used after page load to let the realtime client boot; no application code or data model was modified.
